about.title_1: Building modern, intuitive and accessible digital experiences.
about.text_1: I’m a Junior Full Stack Developer passionate about building modern interfaces, intuitive user experiences and responsive web applications. After several years working in a completely different field, I decided to transition into software development and turn a long-standing personal passion into a professional career.
about.text_2: Over the last few years I’ve been developing projects using React, TypeScript, Java and Spring Boot, while also exploring UI/UX Design, modern animations and accessibility best practices. I enjoy combining logic, design and attention to detail to create digital experiences that are both functional and engaging. I’m curious, determined and always eager to improve my skills.

spotify.title: Spotify clone
spotify.description: Not just a project, but the beginning of everything. This project, developed during my first Build Week at Epicode, was my baptism into the world of programming. With a team of strangers, assigned by the instructor, and armed only with HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and JavaScript, we launched into the challenge of replicating the Spotify interface. We learned to work in a team, managing the workflow with Trello and GitHub, transforming our front-end skills into a functional product. Beyond the code, this project gave life to a solid friendship that still lasts today. This group work is not just a demonstration of my initial technical skills. It's proof that collaboration and passion can turn challenges into successes, creating an unbreakable bond between people. An experience that taught me that the best projects are born from sharing.

pixelpals.title: Pixelpals
pixelpals.description: Find Your Hero in the Gaming World! PixelPals is my platform created to connect gamers, transforming the gaming experience from solitary to a team adventure. This project was developed with the goal of creating an ecosystem where players can easily find the perfect companion or a team to climb the ranks. I designed a system of customizable profiles and intelligent matching that helps users find compatible gaming partners based on tastes and styles. The platform also includes a real-time chat based on WebSocket and exclusive badges to reward dedication to the community. The Technology behind PixelPals Frontend: Developed with React for a dynamic and reactive user interface, and styled with Tailwind CSS for an attractive design. Backend: I used Spring Boot to build a robust backend, supported by a MongoDB database to efficiently manage data. Connectivity: Authentication is managed with JWT, while real-time communication is made possible by WebSocket. This project is not just a demonstration of my technical skills, but also my vision of how technology can create communities and improve the human experience.

llmeteo.title: LLMeteo
llmeteo.description: This is a simple, responsive weather app created in a single afternoon during the first months of my Full Stack Development Master's. The project was conceived as a practical exercise to apply my initial knowledge of web development, particularly using React, Bootstrap, and JavaScript. The application focuses on its main function: providing accurate and immediate weather forecasts. It uses an external weather API to retrieve real-time data and displays it in a responsive interface that adapts to different screen sizes (desktop, tablet, mobile). The choice of Bootstrap allowed for quick and efficient layout and style management, ensuring a good user experience even with my limited knowledge of CSS at the time. Despite its nature as a learning project, the app demonstrates a solid understanding of basic React principles, API handling, and the creation of functional and accessible user interfaces.

applemusic.title: Apple music
applemusic.description: Apple Music Clone. This project represents one of my first steps into the world of front-end development, a small clone of the Apple Music interface created in a single afternoon. The main goal was to test and solidify my initial knowledge of React and, in particular, to apply the concepts of Redux for the first time for state management. The app focuses on its main function: a working search bar that makes API calls to retrieve real-time music data. Thanks to the use of Bootstrap, the interface is fully responsive, ensuring smooth navigation on any device. Despite being a learning project made with limited experience at the time, it demonstrates my ability to quickly understand, apply, and integrate new technologies like React, Redux, JavaScript, and Bootstrap to create a functional and well-structured web application.

llnetflix.title: LLNetflix
llnetflix.description: Netflix Mockup Clone. This project is a faithful replica of a Netflix mockup, created autonomously in a single afternoon as a test during my training. The goal was to challenge my ability to create a complex and fully responsive user interface with React and to handle API calls to connect dynamic data. The application replicates three main sections: a Homepage with dynamic carousels for various categories, a dedicated TV Shows page, and a Details page for each title, with data retrieved in real-time via the IMDB API. Despite the short timeframe, the project demonstrates a solid understanding of React.js, the use of Bootstrap for an efficient layout, and the integration of external APIs to create a dynamic and functional user experience.

prompt-ai.title: Prompt-AI
prompt-ai.description:
Prompt Manager – AI Prompt Management and Customization

This project is a web application designed for anyone working with AI models who wants to organize, edit, and optimize their prompts in a simple and intuitive way.

The app allows you to:
- Create custom prompts, saving title, content, and tags for quick classification.
- Edit and update existing prompts through a clear and interactive interface.
- Manage favorite prompts, with the ability to add or remove prompts from your favorites list.
- View prompts in detail, with all key information and tags organized as chips.
- Search and filter saved prompts by title, content, or tags.
- Interact with smooth animations thanks to Framer Motion and dynamic notifications via SweetAlert2.
- Export and import prompts in JSON format for backup or sharing.

The app is fully responsive, optimized for both desktop and mobile, and uses Redux for global state management, ensuring real-time updates and centralized data handling.

This project is designed as a versatile tool for anyone using AI in content creation, SEO, translation, and script generation, making prompt organization and productivity easier in daily work with language models.

autocare.title: AutoCare
autocare.description:
AutoCare is a smart vehicle management ecosystem designed to transform the stressful and fragmented experience of car ownership into a seamless, intuitive, and emotionally reassuring journey. Conceived as a modern mobile-first experience, the app centralizes every essential aspect of vehicle management into a single elegant interface focused on clarity, prevention, and peace of mind.

The platform allows users to monitor deadlines, expenses, insurance renewals, maintenance schedules, taxes, inspections, and important vehicle documents in real time, eliminating the risk of forgotten payments or unexpected fines. Through intelligent notifications and predictive reminders, AutoCare acts as a personal assistant dedicated to the user's mobility and financial well-being.

The user experience was designed following advanced UI/UX principles centered around cognitive simplicity, accessibility, and emotional trust. Every interaction minimizes friction through intuitive navigation patterns, progressive disclosure, contextual microinteractions, and a clean visual hierarchy optimized for rapid comprehension.

A major focus of the product is collaborative family management. Users can invite family members instantly via QR code or WhatsApp sharing, assign permissions, manage multiple vehicles, and synchronize important updates across shared accounts. This creates a connected household ecosystem where responsibilities become transparent and easy to coordinate.

AutoCare also introduces gamification mechanics to increase user engagement and encourage proactive vehicle maintenance. Through streak systems, progress indicators, smart achievements, and financial insights, users develop healthier organizational habits while gaining greater awareness of their automotive expenses.

The application includes advanced features such as document scanning and digital archiving, editable vehicle profiles, maintenance history tracking, spending analytics, family member management, and centralized vehicle administration. The entire experience is designed to reduce anxiety associated with bureaucratic and financial responsibilities while increasing the user's sense of control and security.

More than a vehicle utility app, AutoCare represents a digital companion designed to improve everyday life through organization, prevention, collaboration, and intelligent user-centered design.

mooddrop.title: MoodDrop
mooddrop.description:
MoodDrop is an emotionally driven digital experience designed to give people a safe and anonymous space to disconnect from external pressure and reconnect with their inner emotional state. Built around simplicity, empathy, and psychological comfort, the app allows users to express how they feel in just a few seconds through an ultra-minimal interaction flow designed to remove friction and emotional fatigue.

With only three taps, users can select their current mood from a curated emotional spectrum and instantly contribute to a collective emotional map that visualizes how people around the world are feeling in real time. The platform transforms anonymous emotional data into a living digital atmosphere where colors, interface elements, and ambient interactions dynamically adapt based on the emotional balance of the community.

The experience was carefully designed following modern UI/UX psychology principles focused on emotional safety, dopamine balance, cognitive relief, and visual calmness. Every component of the interface is intentionally minimalist, reducing overstimulation while creating a meditative and emotionally welcoming environment.

MoodDrop introduces a new form of anonymous emotional social interaction where users feel seen without the pressure of exposure, comparison, or validation mechanisms typical of traditional social networks. There are no followers, no comments, and no performative identity systems. The app instead promotes authenticity, self-awareness, and emotional reflection.

The platform includes an emotional calendar that allows users to track their personal mood evolution over time, helping them recognize behavioral patterns, emotional cycles, and mental trends through elegant data visualization. A streak system gently encourages emotional consistency and self-check-ins without creating unhealthy pressure or addictive dynamics.

One of the app's defining elements is its adaptive visual identity. The entire interface changes colors, gradients, atmosphere, and visual energy according to the dominant mood trends generated by the global community, transforming collective emotion into a shared living experience.

MoodDrop is not designed to replace therapy or mental health support. Instead, it serves as a digital emotional pause — a quiet space where users can feel emotionally present, understood, and connected to humanity in its most honest and vulnerable form.

The project explores the intersection between emotional design, anonymous social interaction, behavioral psychology, and minimalist interface systems, creating a product experience focused on emotional honesty rather than digital performance.
